instruction.text: Rewrite the sentence with the contracted form of the underlined words.

atoms.a: Theo said he <u>cannot</u> play frisbee tomorrow, but my friend from swimming said <u>she will</u> play.
atoms.b: Theo said he ((can’t)) play frisbee tomorrow, but my friend from swimming said ((she’ll)) play.

atoms.a: Rose <u>is not</u> coming to ours tonight; <u>she has</u> got to visit her grandad.
atoms.b: Rose ((isn’t)) coming to ours tonight; ((she’s)) got to visit her grandad.

atoms.a: Since the cows <u>have not</u> been fed, <u>I am</u> going to take them some hay.
atoms.b: Since the cows ((haven’t)) been fed, ((I’m)) going to take them some hay.

atoms.a: The dog <u>has not</u> had a walk for three days; you <u>should have</u> taken her yesterday.
atoms.b: The dog ((hasn’t)) had a walk for three days; you ((should’ve)) taken her yesterday.

atoms.a: As <u>Laura has</u> broken her laptop, <u>she is</u> going to take it to the repair shop.
atoms.b: As ((Laura’s)) broken her laptop, ((she’s)) going to take it to the repair shop.

atoms.a: Tim <u>will not</u> be in school today because <u>he has</u> caught the flu.
atoms.b: Tim ((won’t)) be in school today because ((he’s)) caught the flu.

atoms.a: During half term, I <u>was not</u> as active as I <u>could have</u> been.
atoms.b: During half term, I ((wasn’t)) as active as I ((could’ve)) been.

atoms.a: <u>I am</u> selling my old bike because <u>it is</u> too small for me now.
atoms.b: ((I’m)) selling my old bike because ((it’s)) too small for me now.
